scope: complete nine-action sprite pack; local preview, no deployment

actions.label: Ataque
actions.detail:
Six frames of one elegant powerful RIGHT-HANDED diagonal sword slash toward a foe on screen RIGHT.
1 relaxed ready matching idle, blade down to the left of screen.
2 anticipation: knees flex, torso coils, RIGHT elbow bends to bring sword beside her right shoulder, tip angled upward-left; left arm balances naturally.
3 attack start: right shoulder rotates forward, blade moves up and forward, weight on forward leg, gaze sharp.
4 striking keyframe: right arm extends toward screen RIGHT, blade diagonal forward-down, deep controlled lunge, hair and sash trail opposite motion. One blade only, no duplicate smear weapons.
5 follow-through: torso rotates slightly, right wrist brings blade to lower forward side, elbow begins returning.
6 settle into exact idle ready stance, right sword lowered again. Consistent 3/4 facing; never swap sword to left hand, never mirror character. No special effects; slash VFX will be separate.
actions.prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve.
Asset: real sequential hand-drawn 2D RPG animation sprite sheet for Brisa, the SAME adult human woman as both reference images.
Image 1 is the approved character/costume master; image 2 is her approved idle atlas defining sprite rendering. Preserve the EXACT identity and design: adult graceful proportions, warm fair skin, green eyes, rounded HUMAN ears, honey-blonde long loose hair with small brass clips, sleeveless fitted fern-green/ivory crossover high-collar battle dress, brown waist belt, split green skirt panels lined ivory and long side sash, dark shorts, ivory thigh-high stockings, brown calf boots, ivory forearm fingerless gloves. Sword is ONE straight slim silver blade with small gold guard and green gem, ALWAYS in her anatomical RIGHT hand; left hand never holds the weapon. No new shoulder armor, sleeves, outfit or hairstyle, no pointed ears. Right hand must grip the hilt correctly with opposed thumb, not hold the blade.
Transparent PNG with genuine alpha. No background or haze, no floor, no painted VFX, motion lines, shadows, grid lines, text, logos or numbers. Clean polished anime cel shading matching the idle; not pixel art, not chibi, not photorealism. Fixed camera at 3/4 facing screen RIGHT. Same anatomy, head/leg proportions and weapon length across every cell. Do NOT shrink an individual pose to fit a sword; keep all frames on same scale, fit through pose composition. Each frame must be a meaningfully different sequential animation pose, not duplicate illustrations.
Layout EXACTLY 3 columns by 2 rows, 1536x1024, six equal 512x512 cells in reading order. One complete figure per cell; all body, hair, boots and sword inside cell with 12px clear margin. No overlap between cells. Neutral standing anatomical height roughly 420 px (head crown to sole), neutral crown around y60, ground y480, use same anatomical scale for ALL poses even crouches/jumps. Aim hips near x256. Preserve long legs from reference, no widening/squashing.

actions.label: Guardia / parry
actions.detail:
Six frames of entering sword guard, receiving a block, and recovering WITHOUT COUNTERATTACK.
1 idle ready, blade lowered.
2 right elbow draws blade up in front of body, knees flex.
3 stable guarding stance: right hand near chest holds sword diagonally up-right as barrier, left open hand behind for balance; focused face.
4 blocked impact: body compresses slightly and right elbow yields back a little, boots remain planted, SAME defensive sword orientation, no forward strike.
5 brace and recover guard, steady gaze, hair settles.
6 lower sword back toward idle stance. Do NOT depict any attack, riposte or forward thrust in this sheet. No shield, no circles or painted barrier effects.

actions.label: Daño recibido
actions.grid: Layout EXACTLY 2 columns by 2 rows, 1024x1024, FOUR equal 512x512 cells in reading order. One complete figure per cell with 12px padding; neutral anatomical body height roughly420 px and ground at local y480. Same scale in all four poses.
actions.detail:
Four frames of a brief NON-GRAPHIC hit reaction, keeping sword firmly in RIGHT hand.
1 torso starts recoiling backward away from screen-right threat, eyebrows tense.
2 hit recoil peak: shoulders back, knees bend slightly, eyes wince briefly, left open hand tightens near abdomen; blade still down outside legs, not through body.
3 catches balance, torso straightens partially, hair and cloth settle.
4 recovered idle-ready posture with alert eyes open and right sword down. No wounds or blood, no missing weapon, no enormous theatrical fall.

actions.label: Descanso
actions.detail:
Six frames of short calm recovery/rest to gain focus; no magic painted in.
1 idle ready.
2 shoulders relax, sword remains lowered in right hand, LEFT hand lifts toward upper chest.
3 calm inhale with eyes closed, left palm lightly on upper chest, upright balanced stance.
4 exhale, small shoulder drop and soft fabric motion; no bowing or kneeling.
5 eyes reopen, left hand begins lowering, chin returns to forward gaze.
6 exact ready idle stance. Keep feet grounded in same positions, human breathing not exaggerated movement; sword never changes hand.

actions.label: Desplazamiento
actions.detail:
Six sequential movement poses for dash in and small retreating hop, facing screen RIGHT throughout, body scale consistent even while crouched.
1 anticipation crouch: knees flex, torso forward, sword low in RIGHT hand trailing safely behind, left arm balances.
2 dash start toward right: rear foot pushes off, torso inclines forward, loose hair/skirt trail left.
3 airborne low forward stride: legs extended naturally, right sword still trails low behind body, left arm forward; no sword swap.
4 retreat takeoff: body turns torso slightly but face stays right, knees gather for a SMALL backward hop to screen LEFT, right sword held close and low.
5 airborne backward hop: bent knees, head upright, hair flowing toward right after direction change, right hand retains sword.
6 soft landing into idle feet positions, knees slightly flexed, sword lowered. Include entire weapon in each frame. Do not add trails, dust or change camera.

actions.label: Activación especial
actions.detail:
Six frames of a neutral skill activation gesture, compatible with any equipped skill, NOT a fixed wind attack.
1 idle ready, right sword low.
2 torso straightens, left open hand rises palm-up near waist as if gathering resolve.
3 left palm forward at chest height, right sword draws diagonally alongside body without crossing face.
4 firm activation key pose: left palm extends toward screen RIGHT, feet grounded, intense focused gaze, right sword kept vertical beside her near shoulder, NOT switched to left hand.
5 retract left arm, right blade begins lowering, cloth follows motion.
6 return to exact idle ready stance. No aura, magic orb, circle, particles or glowing body painted into sprite; effects separate.

actions.label: Victoria
actions.detail:
Six frames of an elegant restrained victory celebration with a clear return.
1 ready stance, expression begins softening, right sword still lowered.
2 small confident smile, right elbow bends lifting sword for a respectful salute.
3 salute peak: right sword held VERTICAL beside shoulder, face clearly visible, left hand relaxed on hip, chin slightly raised. Whole blade inside cell by using bent elbow and angled arm; maintain anatomy scale.
4 brief happy eyes-closed blink in SAME salute pose, hair gently settles, no change in sword angle.
5 eyes reopen, right wrist and elbow LOWER sword halfway visibly (essential transition, not instantaneous drop).
6 end in the EXACT approved idle stance, soft smile, right sword down, left hand relaxed. No raised fist, no sword toss or new props. Avoid sudden up/down blade pop; intermediate frame5 must be distinct.

actions.label: Derrota
actions.detail:
Six frames of NON-GRAPHIC defeat with smooth collapse and stable final pose.
1 stagger, knees soften, left hand to upper abdomen, right sword lowered.
2 lower onto one knee, shoulders slump, right hand retains sword, sword point near ground outside legs.
3 both knees near ground, left palm braces against ground, head lowered, hair falls naturally.
4 settles onto her side, right arm and sword remain visible outside body, long cloth folds under legs without becoming a new outfit.
5 final lying-on-side resting pose, eyes closed, sword still beside right hand, entire body and sword visible, no blood or injuries.
6 SAME final lying pose with only a small settled hair/cloth variation, so final hold is coherent. DO NOT make fallen frames anatomically bigger or zoom in. No gravestone, no disappearance. Ground line y480 even for fallen frames, falling body stays naturally same size.
